If the workspace doesn’t open

  1. On your Mac, open the careeros folder in your home folder.
  2. Double-click Start CareerOS.command. Keep its window open.
  3. Return here and click Open CareerOS. Use your browser’s normal Reload button for updates.

This home page can be bookmarked and opened independently. The buttons open the existing app on this computer; they do not move your database or private documents online. On another device, the local workspace links won’t reach your Mac.
